description:
About this Video:
HDFC Life and ICICI Pru are some of the biggest insurance companies in India. The stocks of these companies have also given good returns to their investors. But, new investors are always puzzled and are unable to choose the better stock to invest in between these two. Through this video, I have tried to solve their problem. I have compared the fundamentals of these two companies and also their valuations. I have discussed how the life insurance industry is expected to perform in the future. I am sure this video will add value to your knowledge and portfolio. 

**********

0:00 - Welcome Message

3:35 - Growth Prospects

12:35 - Valuations & Chart Analysis

I am Varun Agarwal. I am a Chartered Accountant & Serial Entrepreneur. I am a mentor for budding entrepreneurs and investors. Through this channel, I am making an effort to share the maximum knowledge and experience which I can with you all. Join me in my journey of earning through learning by the exchange of knowledge that we all have.
